resolutions.action: CORRECTION RECORDED RATHER THAN OVERWRITTEN, per the finding's own recommendation. The seven over-reported entries are the ones whose resolutions this walk has now actually applied: the three CRITICALs (succession vacuity, empty-array readability, severity-blind existence) and four WARNING-grade edits (the quantifier-convention preamble, the freshness home, the earliest-pair subordination, the repeat-bound restatement).
